text:
Risk-off morning. Nasdaq futures are -1.6% and S&P futures -0.9%. Asia fell about 3% overnight. The light is still GREEN (VIX 18.0), but tech is likely to open lower. 2 trading days remain before the Fri Oct 23 sell-by.
Plan: SELL ALL three holdings today at the open. Yesterday's bounce took the account to $2,464. Futures point to giving some of that back, and waiting for Friday adds risk to money that's needed by Oct 30.
The engine lists MA as a buy. Skip it, because a 1–2 day hold has no edge.
At yesterday's close: CRWD -12.3%, SNOW -2.2%, AMD +0.9%. Account $2,462 (-1.5%) vs system simulated -9.1% and S&P +0.2% since Sep 28.
After selling, withdraw the cash so it arrives before Oct 30.
